تختبرون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِرُونَ (taḵtabirūna) /tax.ta.bi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# تُخْتَبَرُونَ (tuḵtabarūna) /tux.ta.ba.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
